prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a refined 16:9 landscape Chinese timeline explaining one controlled real-RXE PUT recovery test in RailFuse. White background, thin navy lines, teal normal flow, amber observer, green verified content. Concise readable labels. This is an explanatory test diagram, not a fake terminal screenshot.
Title: “先排空旧完成，再让同一注册区域继续工作”
Timeline six stages, ordered clearly left to right:
1 “受控隐藏 CQ 轮询结果”
2 “退休旧 QP”
3 “读取真实 WC”
4 “错误返回”
5 “显式重连”
6 “三轮 PUT / GET”
Under stage 1 show a small observer box labeled “poll 暂返 0”; a distinct actual queue below is labeled “真实 Verbs 完成队列”. Its actual completion record stays in that queue until stage 3. An arrow from the actual queue to stage 3 must be labeled “provider 真实完成事件”. Do NOT draw the observer generating a completion.
Under stages 2–4 add a bracket/callout “旧完成事件在错误返回前排空”.
Across all six stages draw two thin persistent lanes: one “同一 Python 句柄”, one “同一注册区域 / MR”. They continue intact to three small green checks under stage 6 labeled “完整内容核对”. Indicate old QP and new connection as distinct lifecycle boxes, without requiring different QP numbers.
Footer exact: “受控 CQ 观察；WC 内容未伪造。允许 RXE 立即复用 QP 编号。”
Small secondary note: “这是受控故障验证，不代表无注入自然超时。”
Critical: preserve event order retire old QP → drain real CQ completion → return error → explicit reconnect; same registration remains available. Avoid physical-HCA claims or invented timings, rates or benchmark scores.
targeted_edit_prompt: Make three precise semantic wording corrections while preserving all timeline arrows, six stages, persistent handle/MR lanes and footer. (1) In stage 3 blue WC card, replace the invented bullet fields '状态：成功 / 操作：PUT / 仍来自旧QP' with simply 'provider 实际返回的 WC' and '核对旧请求的真实完成'. Do not depict PUT as a Verbs WC opcode, and do not invent any WC field values. Keep the provider-real-event arrow from the actual queue. (2) In stage 4 red error card, replace '后续操作返回错误（如QP失败）' with the precise '本次 PUT 返回错误'; this stage is the original request's error return, not a subsequent request failing. (3) In the green full-content-check card under stage6 replace the lower text '三轮数据均正确 / 注册区域内容一致' with '三轮逐一匹配期望内容'. No implication that different rounds use the same payload. Preserve exact stage order and all other content, white/navy/teal style,16:9.
